'''Shelby Abercrombie''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Gold 97 from East Tuscaloosa, AL.<ref name="sm-fan" /> At DecipherCon 1999 Shelby finished 28th in the [[Young Jedi]] YJ Qualifier #2 (Sealed Deck).<ref name="dc99yj02_2">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ02_2.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: YJ Qualifier #2 (Sealed Deck)], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010108185300/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ02_2.html Internet Archive]</ref> Abercrombie was a finalist at the [[1998 Decipher World Championship]] and qualified through Dagobah Mobile from Enterprise, Alabama.<ref name="pkt">[https://blog.categoryonegames.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/07/1998-World-Championship.pdf 1998 World Championship packet], Decipher / Kendrick Summers (20 November 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195330/https://blog.categoryonegames.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/07/1998-World-Championship.pdf Internet Archive].</ref> Abercrombie won the [[1997 Dagobah Regionals (Mobile)]] and played the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dec97q">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html 1997 Regionals and Open Events], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990503132332/http://search.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html Internet Archive]</ref>
